==Biography==
'''Zantins''' first appeared in the Brazilian competitive scene playing for '''[[Seven Wars e-Sports]]''', impressing the scene at the [[IEM Season VIII - Sao Paulo|Intel Extreme Masters - São Paulo]] in the beginning of 2014.

After some time playing for [[Cyber Gamer e-Sports|Cyber Gamer]] and [[Frequency Gaming]], and after being banned for one year by Riot Games due to elo-boosting, Zantins reappeared during the [[Brazilian Challenger Circuit/2015 Season/Split 1|2015 Brazilian Challenger Circuit Split 1]] playing for '''[[Keyd Warriors]]''', qualifying to the [[CBLOL/2015 Season/Split 2 Promotion|Split 2 Promotion Series]] and getting the [[CBLOL/2015 Season/Split 2|2015 CBLOL Split 2]] spot with the team, which later became '''[[g3nerationX]]'''.

In January 2021, Zantins announced his retirement, while also joining Globo's sports website '''ge''' as their CBLOL analyst.<ref>[https://twitter.com/Zantins/status/1351608696707706880 Zantins's Tweet (Portuguese)] ''twitter.com''</ref>

== Trivia ==
